name: orchestrator
description: Standalone fleet orchestrator. Talks to the AgentHydra daemon over HTTP; owns no state of its own.

scripts.//remote: THE REMOTE FRONT-END (web/ + server/): a Bun+Hono gateway that serves the Vue dashboard, gates it behind Sign in with Connections, and opens a Cloudflare tunnel - RepoYeti's remote-access stack, vendored. The Python toolbox stays stdlib-only; this is the one TypeScript surface, because the auth stack lives there.
scripts.remote:typecheck: bun run --cwd web typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck

config.//remotePort: THE remote gateway's loopback port, written only here. server/src/config.ts, scripts/remote.py, scripts/remote_tunnel.py (the named tunnels' Cloudflare ingress), scripts/tray.ps1 and web/vite.config.ts all read it; ORCH_REMOTE_PORT overrides it for one run. 7790 was ZSwarm's MCP server (retired 2026-10-03; chats started before then still knock on it), 7791 is the Connections local MCP, 7793 is HSwarm's shared MCP server (the gateway sat there until 2026-10-04 and could not bind it) and 7787-7789 are the AgentHydra daemon's port hops. Changing it means re-running remote_tunnel.py --provision for BOTH tunnels, or their ingress keeps pointing at the old port.
